title: Stack iterators
hints: Each method returns a closure that loops over `s.items`. The closure reads the stack when it runs, not when the method is called.

`All`: `for i := len(s.items) - 1; i >= 0; i--` and yield `s.items[i]`. `Backward`: `for _, v := range s.items`. `Drain`: an endless `for` that calls `s.Pop()` and stops when the stack is empty or `yield` returns `false`.
